theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 23 群

items.colloc: even out the workload 平均分配工作量 | even out the differences 平衡差異
items.distinct: level off 趨於平穩 | smooth out 解決問題
ex: These measures will help even out the seasonal fluctuations.
這些措施將有助於平衡季節性波動。
We need to even out the distribution of tasks among staff.
我們需要平衡員工之間的工作分配。
Our sales figures began to even out after the campaign.
促銷活動後我們的銷售數字開始趨於平穩。

items.colloc: except for the fact that 除了事實是… | except for one detail 除了一個細節
items.distinct: apart from 除了...之外（包含/不包含） | besides 此外
ex: The office was empty except for the security guard.
除了保全人員之外，辦公室裡空無一人。
Everything is ready except for the signed contract.
除了已簽署的合約外，所有項目都已就緒。
The report is accurate except for a few minor errors.
除了幾個小錯誤外，該報告內容相當準確。

items.colloc: send by express mail 用快遞寄送 | express mail service 快遞服務
items.distinct: courier 遞送員/快遞服務 | priority mail 優先郵件
ex: Please send the documents by express mail tomorrow morning.
請明天早上用快遞寄送這些文件。
The express mail arrived at the office by noon.
快遞在中午前送達辦公室。
I opted for express mail to ensure timely delivery.
我選擇快遞以確保及時送達。

items.colloc: face away from the camera 背對鏡頭 | face away from the window 背對窗戶
items.distinct: face toward 面向 | turn away 轉身離開
ex: The desk is positioned to face away from the door.
辦公桌的位置設計成背對著門。
He sat at the table and faced away from me.
他坐在桌邊並背對著我。
Please ensure your chair does not face away from the screen.
請確保您的椅子沒有背對著螢幕。

items.colloc: fall behind schedule 進度落後 | fall behind on payments 繳款逾期
items.distinct: lag behind 滯後 | catch up 趕上
ex: The construction project started to fall behind last month.
營建工程上個月開始進度落後。
We cannot afford to fall behind our main competitors.
我們不能輸給主要競爭對手。
If we fall behind on deadlines, we will face penalties.
如果我們錯過截止日期，將會面臨罰款。

items.colloc: a family run business 家族企業 | family run restaurant 家族經營餐館
items.distinct: corporation 大型企業 | franchise 加盟連鎖店
ex: This local hotel has been a family run enterprise since 1980.
這家在地旅館自1980年以來一直是家族經營。
They prefer to invest in small family run companies.
他們偏好投資小型家族企業。
Our family run bakery values traditional recipes and quality.
我們家族經營的烘焙坊重視傳統配方與品質。

items.colloc: figure out a solution 想出解決方案 | figure out how to operate 操作弄懂
items.distinct: work out 計算出/解決 | realize 意識到
ex: I am trying to figure out why the system failed.
我正試著找出系統故障的原因。
Management is still figuring out the budget for next year.
管理層仍在規劃明年的預算。
We need to figure out a better way to communicate.
我們需要想出更好的溝通方式。

items.colloc: fold in half carefully 小心對折 | fold in half horizontally 水平對折
items.distinct: fold over 摺疊覆蓋 | roll up 捲起來
ex: Please fold the flyer in half before putting it in envelopes.
請將傳單對折後再放入信封。
You should fold the paper in half to fit the file.
你應該把紙對折以放入檔案夾。
Fold the document in half and staple the edge.
將文件對折並將邊緣裝訂起來。

items.colloc: fold up the chairs 收起椅子 | fold up the screen 收起屏風
items.distinct: put away 收好 | pack up 打包
ex: Staff will fold up the tables after the conference ends.
會議結束後工作人員會將桌子收起來。
She began to fold up the laundry after it dried.
她開始將曬乾的衣物摺疊收好。
Please fold up your laptop before leaving the meeting room.
離開會議室前請將您的筆記型電腦蓋上收好。

items.colloc: follow up on a lead 追蹤商機 | follow up on an inquiry 跟進詢問
items.distinct: keep track of 紀錄 | monitor 監控
ex: I need to follow up on the customer's recent feedback.
我需要追蹤客戶最近的意見回饋。
The manager will follow up on the results next week.
經理下週會跟進相關結果。
Please follow up on the email you sent this morning.
請追蹤您今天早上寄出的那封信件。

items.colloc: at the front door 在前門 | lock the front door 鎖上大門
items.distinct: main entrance 主要入口 | lobby 大廳
ex: Visitors should report to the desk by the front door.
訪客請向大門旁的櫃台報到。
The delivery person left the box at the front door.
外送人員將箱子放在了大門口。
Please ensure the front door is locked before leaving.
離開前請確認大門已經鎖好。

items.colloc: sell frozen food products 販售冷凍食品 | launch a frozen food product 推出冷凍食品
items.distinct: fresh produce 新鮮農產品 | canned goods 罐頭食品
ex: Our company is launching a new line of frozen food products.
我們公司即將推出一系列新的冷凍食品。
This frozen food product contains no artificial preservatives.
這款冷凍食品不含人工防腐劑。
The supermarket expanded its range of frozen food products.
該超市擴增了冷凍食品的品項。

items.colloc: store gardening tools 收納園藝工具 | high-quality gardening tool 高品質園藝工具
items.distinct: household appliance 家用電器 | construction equipment 營建設備
ex: He bought a set of professional gardening tools for the yard.
他為院子買了一套專業園藝工具。
Please keep the gardening tools in the shed after use.
使用後請將園藝工具放在工具棚內。
She is looking for a durable gardening tool for pruning.
她正在尋找一把耐用的修剪園藝工具。

items.colloc: gather up the files 收集文件 | gather up the supplies 收拾物資
items.distinct: collect 收集 | tidy up 整理
ex: The assistant will gather up all the handouts for the meeting.
助理會為會議收集所有的講義。
We need to gather up our belongings before the train arrives.
火車到站前我們需要收拾好隨身物品。
Please gather up the scattered papers on the conference table.
請將會議桌上散亂的文件收集起來。

items.colloc: an indoor gathering space 室內聚會空間 | public gathering space 公共集會空間
items.distinct: meeting room 會議室 | lounge 休息室
ex: The hotel offers a spacious gathering space for corporate events.
這家飯店為企業活動提供了寬敞的聚會空間。
Employees use the break room as a casual gathering space.
員工將休息室當作非正式的聚會空間。
The architectural design includes a central gathering space.
建築設計中包含了一個中央聚會場所。

items.colloc: the general population 的一般大眾 | represent the general population 代表大眾
items.distinct: target audience 目標客群 | demographic 人口統計
ex: These products are designed for the general population.
這些產品是為一般大眾所設計的。
The survey results reflect the views of the general population.
問卷調查結果反映了一般大眾的觀點。
Access to healthcare is a concern for the general population.
醫療照護的可及性是一般大眾關心的議題。

items.colloc: bridge the generation gap 跨越代溝 | the generation gap issue 代溝問題
items.distinct: cultural difference 文化差異 | communication barrier 溝通障礙
ex: The company is trying to bridge the generation gap among staff.
公司正試圖彌合員工之間的代溝。
Sometimes a generation gap causes misunderstandings in teamwork.
有時代溝會導致團隊合作中的誤解。
Mentorship programs can help reduce the generation gap.
導師制度有助於縮小世代差異。

items.colloc: get alone well 獨處得好 | time to get alone 需要獨處時間
items.distinct: be alone 獨自一人 | get along 相處融洽
ex: Sometimes I need time to get alone and focus on work.
有時我需要時間獨處並專注於工作。
She prefers to get alone in the library to study.
她偏好在圖書館獨處進行研究。
Finding space to get alone in a busy office is difficult.
在忙碌的辦公室中找空間獨處很困難。

items.colloc: get along with colleagues 與同事相處 | get along with the team 與團隊相處
items.distinct: work with 與...共事 | deal with 處理
ex: It is important to get along with your teammates.
與隊友相處融洽是很重要的。
She finds it easy to get along with everyone in the office.
她發現自己很容易與辦公室裡的每個人相處。
He tries to get along with all his business partners.
他試著與所有的商業夥伴保持良好的關係。

items.colloc: get in line for the event 為活動排隊 | get in line at the counter 在櫃檯排隊
items.distinct: wait in line 等候隊伍 | stand in line 站著排隊
ex: Customers began to get in line before the store opened.
顧客在商店開門前就開始排隊了。
Please get in line to register for the seminar.
請排隊報名參加研討會。
There were many people waiting to get in line for tickets.
有許多人等著排隊購買門票。
